Bangalore is known as India's Silicon Valley. A short drive from here, there are tons of breathtaking scenery that make a weekend getaway so perfectly suited. Whether it is an escape from the commotion of life, thrilling adventures or historical sites, every individual will find something within just 200 kilometers of this typical brewing city. Best places to visit near Bangalore This article unearths some of the best places you could go and ensure your experience is unforgettable in a short drive from Bangalore.

Table Of Contents

Nandi Hills is one of the ultimate hill stations around Bangalore, perfect for family holidays. This idyllic hill fortress surrounds lush greenery, mesmerizing views, ancient shrines, and historical monuments. Once a summer palace for Tipu Sultan, it is placed on an enormous granite hill that is the highest point in the state.

Nandi Hills, at an elevation of 4851 feet above sea level, is also referred to as Nandidurg. One of the most famous hill stations near Bangalore, Nandi Hills offers various adventure activities that you can enjoy along with your family. There are countless ways to enjoy a vacation and create new memories with your close ones at Nandi Hills.

Places to visit: Yoga Nandeeshwara Temple, Tipu’s Drop, Bhoga Nandeeshwara Temple, Tipu’s Summer Residence
Activities for Weekend: Trekking, Paragliding, Cycling
Distance from Bangalore: 62 km

Mysore is quite famously known to be the city of palaces with a rich cultural heritage. Every detail of your experience from its gardens to its palaces, effortlessly gets captured. Their aura is magnificent, and their construction is royalty and easy to get lost in the world of kings, queens, princes, and princesses. Alongside this are historical landmarks such as the Mysore Zoo, one of the oldest in India. It comprises different species of wild life and is believed to be one of the best places to visit near Bangalore within 200 kms. The city also comprises some iconic temples which offer panoramic views of the city. Due to the majestic oasis, it has become a destination for sightseeing wanderers, and it is one of the topmost tourist attractions near Bangalore within 200 km which must be visited.

Places to visit: Mysore Palace, Brindavan Garden, Mysore Zoo,Chamundeshwari Temple, Karanji Lake,Somnathpur Temple
Activities for Weekend: Spotting wildlife in the zoo, Exotic species of flowers in the garden, Sightseeing tour
Distance from Bangalore: 145 km

Hogenakkal Falls is the best place in India to visit any picturesque waterfalls or to take therapeutic baths. Only a few know about it despite being called the Niagra Falls of India. Due to not many people knowing about it and also the fact that it is a small town, it is a beautiful place to go for tranquillity and peace. Metture Dam, Crocodile Park, Hogenakaal Falls, and Melagiri Hills are some of the known tourist spots in the town.

Places to visit: Mettur Dam, Pennagaram Village, Theerthamalai Temple,Hogenakkal Falls,Melagiri Hills
Things to do: Trekking, Boating, Visiting Temples, and Oil Massage.
Distance from Bangalore:125.6 km

For someone interested in knowing history about Bangalore small towns and cities, Hassan is one of the must-visit places near Bangalore within 200 km. Hassan is named after the Hindu goddess Hassanamba. The inscriptions and monuments show that the history dates back to the 11th century. Some mysteries follow with rich diversity of temples. In parallel, there are also pretty famous dams-like the Gorur Dam, built along the Hemavathi River, with a flock of birds around it, so birthplaces To Visit In Bangalore In Juneatchers or leisure travellers can enjoy this place.

Places to visit: Hoysala Temple, Gorur Dam, Kedareshwar Temple, Lakshmi Narasimha Temple, Koravangala Temple
Activities for Weekend: Rafting, Kayaking, Swimming in Tungabhadra River,Trekking in Kabbaligere Hill,
Distance from Bangalore: 182 Km

Lepakshi is a real gem of Andhra Pradesh, which offers multiple attractions. You can choose it as your next family weekend destination and make your holiday eventful. Lepakshi is among the perfect tourist destinations near Bangalore for family that gives a quintessential blend of natural beauty and pilgrim spots. You will get numerous things to explore and experience in Lepakshi as it is full of bountiful nature and mystic temples.

More than 110 temples of Lord Shiva along with the Skandagiri Hills attract tourism from each and every corner of the country. Kalyana Mandapa will give you a glimpse of incredible history within the regions. Lepakshi never misses a moment to surprise you with its unique charm, in order to get a view of cloud blankets to feel the spiritual aura.

Places to visit: Lepakshi Temple, Nandi Bull and Painting, and Balaji Film Talkies,Veerabhadra Temple
Things to do: Trekking, Photography, Visiting Temples, and Shopping
Distance from Bangalore:130KM

It is located along the shores of River Cauvery in the Mandya district of Karnataka. The place is an adventure paradise as well as being a huge attraction for families planning an entire family vacation. That apart, the other face of Bheemeshwari reveals it as a quiet town and maybe a reason that it features on the list of one of the most popular family-friendly near Bangalore.

This place is also known for a plethora of fishing camps and is a paradise for adventure lovers. One can enjoy boating, camping, fishing, trekking, and several watersports activities here with close ones. A lush green forest surrounds this place which has rich flora and fauna. This place has a natural habitat for Mahseer which attracts a large number of tourists.

Places to visit: Bheemeshwari Wildlife Sanctuary, Doddamakali, Galibore Fishing Camp,Cauvery Fishing Camp,
Activities for Weekend: Bird watching, Trekking, Fishing, Wildlife Safari, Angling,Boating,
Distance from Bangalore:100 km

Conclusion

Bangalore has the most wonderful tourist attractions within 200 kilometers that accommodates all forms of interest-in adventure sports, culture sites, or simply relaxing in nature. Each has in them something to give you an experience that allows you to break free from the business of the city and take in the beautiful setting or learn the history.

Whether you take the family out or want to have a fun trip with your friends, these locations would surely make some lovely memories. They are close to Bangalore, so perfect for quick getaways from the city to revitalize the spirit. So pack your bags and be off to explore these wonderful places just outside the city.
